title: Collage board
description: Three original graphic studies can be moved into a persistent, overlapping composition.
useCase: Freeform visual arrangement in a compact board.
interaction: Drag a study, or focus it and use arrow keys.
reducedMotion: Positions change directly; raised shadow feedback is removed.
limitations: Three local SVG studies; no image import or saved composition.
look: Light grey board with three tilted, overlapping poster cards: black blob on off-white, black rings on yellow, and white italic serif letters on black.
motion: Grabbing a card brings it to the front and deepens its shadow over 140 ms while it follows the pointer within the board; arrow keys nudge it 2.5%.
adapt: Positions are normalised `pieces` updated by `move` (clamped to the board, bottom limit 0.88); `selected` sets `zIndex` and `data-dragging` triggers the deeper `box-shadow`. Replace the three inline SVG studies and `names`, and persist `pieces` if needed.
